implementation_report.derivation: Existing numeric domains and identities justify guarded scalar leaves; checked homogeneous function signatures imply fold return carriers; unordered folds require associative and commutative laws independently of their desired value; finite maps consume stored certificates. Existing choice definitions justify publication, while stored bijectivity plus a codomain member justifies a unique preimage. No new public theorem, implicit quantifier policy or protected state owner is needed.

source_identity.resolution: Preserved the previous snapshot, rebuilt the stable canonical release, reran focused tests and all selected CLI gates against the final frozen binary.

controls.C07-noncomm-finite-reduce: Rejected as required; subtraction is not an unordered fold operation.
controls.fold-unproved-laws: Rejected; a bare homogeneous signature does not establish the two laws.
controls.fold-arbitrary-carrier-certified: Accepted for a general E carrier with both explicit laws.
controls.C17-coprime-false: Name is misleading: not $coprime(0,0) is mathematically true and remains accepted.
controls.C21-eval-false-floor: An eval command rather than a false assertion; correctly evaluates floor(-2.5) to -3.

remaining_boundaries: D01: real-exponent power domains remain a documented implementation-contract mismatch; implementation has R×N, C×N and nonzero C×Z. No new exponent/domain semantics introduced.
D02: Cartesian by-for enumeration remains outside the documented current boundary.
D03: try/session speculative protocol is absent from current Stmt and CLI.
D04: legacy finite-list syntax would require an Obj interface change.
D05: legacy example-block syntax would require a statement/publication contract.
implementation_report.skipped_gates: No whole-repository, full examples, textbook, Lean or release-package gate: changes are L2 local rule families plus L3 proof/evaluator producer-consumer wiring.
implementation_report.cli_drift: Used supported -strict -e/-f commands. Current CLI has no -compact/-runner/-before or try block protocol; no session protocol was added.
